<observation>
  <type>discovery</type>
  <title>Claude provider is the fallback observation backend</title>
  <subtitle>ClaudeProvider handles native SDK observation generation when no configured Gemini or OpenRouter provider is available.</subtitle>
  <facts>
    <fact>ClaudeProvider reads CLAUDE_MEM_MODEL and resolves tier aliases at request time.</fact>
    <fact>ClaudeProvider classifies setup, authentication, quota, rate-limit, context, invalid-request, and transient failures through ClassifiedProviderError.</fact>
    <fact>ClaudeProvider streams initialization, observation, and summary prompts through the Anthropic Agent SDK and forwards responses to ResponseProcessor.</fact>
  </facts>
  <narrative>ClaudeProvider is the native SDK-backed provider and the final fallback in provider-dispatch. It manages isolated Claude subprocess environments, session conversation history, prompt generation, recycling, compression, model-tier resolution, and response processing. Its error classifier distinguishes permanent setup/configuration failures from retryable provider and transport failures, providing the common error taxonomy that a future Codex provider should implement.</narrative>
  <concepts>
    <concept>how-it-works</concept>
    <concept>pattern</concept>
  </concepts>
  <files_read>
    <file>src/services/worker/ClaudeProvider.ts</file>

</observation>
